title: Leray--Hopf Type Weak Solutions for the Three-Dimensional Beris--Edwards System with Stable Landau--de Gennes Potential
summary: We prove existence of a weak solution to the three-dimensional Beris--Edwards system in the whole space under the stable bulk assumption $c>0$. The solution satisfies the natural bounds $Q\in L^\infty_tH^1_x\cap L^2_tH^2_x$ and $u\in L^\infty_tL^2_x\cap L^2_tH^1_x$, the distributional form of the equations, and the expanded Leray--Hopf type energy inequality used in weak--strong uniqueness arguments.
